UI state machine

Baseline → Capturing → BudgetExceeded → Tuning → ComparingAlternative → AcceptedForMeasuredPopulation

WBP_Diagnostics observes results from URPGReplicationPolicy. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_NetworkBudget_Development. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
RelevantRadiusCm: per actor-family proposal, not visibility authority
NetUpdateFrequency/Dormancy: engine settings verified against installed version before use
PresentationSnapshot: action/facing/start-time/equipment IDs only
OwnerOnlyFacts: inventory/currency/quests/private state
NetworkProfile: latency, jitter, loss and bandwidth limits recorded per test
BenchmarkRecord: build/content/hardware/clientcount/duration/p95 metrics

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGReplicationPolicyImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_DiagnosticsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
CollectNetworkSample(ActorFamily, Bytes, Relevancy) -> Metric; development instrumentation
ApplyMeasuredReplicationProfile(ProfileId) -> Applied|Unsupported
CompareReplicationCandidate(BaselineRunId, CandidateRunId) -> ReviewRecord; test procedure, not game API

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Separate public world facts, owner-only character facts and cosmetic cues before choosing replication settings.
  2. Generic replication sends movement and approved properties/RPCs; client sprite playback resolves compact state instead of replicating every sprite frame.
  3. Resource actors become dormant when stable and explicitly wake on claim/depletion changes; late relevant clients receive the correct state, not only a past multicast event.
  4. Measure actor/channel counts, bytes, RPCs, server tick and client render cost with representative AI/loot/projectiles; control the same scene and population for comparisons.
  5. Profile generic baseline first. Select either Iris or Replication Graph in an isolated branch only when installed support and actual measurements justify migration.
  6. Retest owner privacy, late join, dormancy wake, loss and zone handoff after every optimization. Never hide a valid combat target on the server because a client did not render it.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Add read-only counters to WBP_Diagnostics for net role, ping, current zone/epoch, relevant actor counts and received revision.
  2. Set owner-only replication on private character projections; inspect remote clients for inventory/currency leaks.
  3. Configure development network emulation using the installed engine network emulation settings/console help; record actual commands and verify whether latency applies per direction.
  4. Run the same route at no impairment, 100ms RTT, 200ms RTT with jitter, and 2% loss; the exact emulation knob syntax is an installed-engine verification task.
  5. Record captures from server plus two geographically separate or separately hosted clients, not only multi-PIE windows in one process.
  6. Do not change Actor tick, update frequency and relevancy all at once; change one controlled variable and compare regression outcomes.

Reopen Phase22 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_LoadTest / distributed clients / latency-jitter-loss profiles. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Resource wakes from dormancy -> all newly relevant clients see depletion and cannot claim a stale generation.
Loss of cosmetic event -> later state converges without repeating rewards.
High latency inventory click -> pending state persists; no optimistic currency authority.
Remote player disappears outside interest radius -> quest/reward credit uses server policy, not visual presence.
Iris and Replication Graph both configured -> configuration validation fails before a performance comparison.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Initial diagnostic hypotheses: 30Hz dedicated simulation target, 16 players/zone, 100 active AI and 40 active resources in a test scene. These are load inputs, not achieved capacities. Establish acceptable p95 tick and bandwidth from target hardware and provider limits.

Retain reproducible build/hardware/input/load records, raw captures and measured percentile summaries. Report the largest tested population and bottleneck; do not extrapolate to thousands without evidence.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
